Island 2.2: round 3, the translation at the start of the conveyor

The validated conveyor now begins with medical textual data, the translator with island 2.1 inside, and the TransCorpus-bio-fr logo that trains the tokenizer; the rest of the line is as validated. Island 2.1 becomes a sub-island, entered from the translation. The author prefers design 2 (CHOICE.md); designs 1 and 3 are shown as they were on 23 October. Click one for whole, 1/3, 1/20 and beside the validated conveyor. The translator alone, with its bubbles and with 2.1 inside: its draft sheet. 23 October 2026.

1. The translation over the queue

The conveyor untouched; above its first stretch, the medical data, the translator with island 2.1 on its large screen, and an arrow onto the TransCorpus-bio-fr logo over the tokenizer. The island grows left and up only by the start. 1229 × 1265.

2. The compact start

The author's choice (24 October 2026). The same row fitted inside the conveyor's width, the tokenizer with its logo moved 120 units along its own belt (r2-1's TOK_SHIFT). Revised: the translator's screen shows only the box of 2.1, its three strips, on an upright machine, and the translator is larger. 946 × 1203.

3. The feeder belt

The conveyor begins with the data: a short belt of the same conveyor starts under the medical data, runs through the translator's two slots, a page riding it on each side, and ends in the TransCorpus-bio-fr logo. 1237 × 1250.

Design 2, with 2.1 laid in the translator

The author, 24 October 2026: “2.1 could be integrated way better in the translator. why a black bezel? why white board spilling on the left and right of 2.1... It should be perfectly integrated.” Design 2 above keeps the screen. Here are four ways of laying 2.1's box edge to edge in the machine: no screen, no bezel, no paper round it, 2.1's geometry as signed. The translator alone in each way, labelled 1 to 5: its draft sheet.

2a. The compact start, inlay

Inlaid: no screen; the casing is fitted to the box and wraps it edge to edge, the three strips set into its face, each over an offset darker copy of itself. The translator fills the row. 946 × ~1230.

2b. The compact start, rim

The box's border is the machine's frame: the casing only as wide as the box and the slots' lips, outlined in 2.1's own ink and weight. The translator fills the row. 946 × ~1230.

2c. The compact start, cutaway

Cut away: a wall of casing round an opening into the machine; the box mounted inside, its wall in shadow at the top and left. The translator fills the row. 946 × ~1230.

2d. The compact start, glass

A glass case: no casing face; the box stands in a lilac-white glass case on the machine's base, a white highlight on the glass. The translator fills the row. 946 × ~1230.
